sections.content: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) controls presentation: colors, fonts, spacing, layout. It applies rules made of selectors and declarations.
The cascade decides conflicts: more specific selectors win, then later rules, then !important (use sparingly).
Key points: separate content (HTML) from presentation (CSS), external stylesheets beat inline styles for maintainability.
